jobs.descriptionText:
The Opportunity
The CTO team is seeking a visionary, hands-on engineering leader to design, build, and scale HSBC Agent Platform as a core capability within the Group AI Platform. This role will deliver secure, reusable and high-performance platform services that enables team across the bank to build, deploy and operate agentic and generative AI solutions consistently, overing orchestration, tool integration, memory, evaluation and governance-by-design. You’ll set the technical direction, drive reliability and adoption at scale and ensure the platform meets enterprise standard for performance, resilience, security and controls.
What You’ll Do
Define the long-term technical vision and roadmap for the Agent platform in collaboration with product management team
Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of a robust, scalable, and high-performance Agent platform
Stay at the cutting edge of AI and agent movement in the industry, and adapt the agent platform to leverage the technical evolving in the industry
Work closely with technology teams across business lines to understand their requirements and ensure the platform empowers them to build agents efficiently
Integrate agent platform as part of the Group AI Platform which spans on-premise and cloud-based infrastructure
Build and manage a high-performing global team of ML SMEs and full stack engineers, to ensure the AI capabilities are built fit for purpose with high quality
Establish engineering best practices, including continuous integration / continuous delivery pipeline workflows, automation testing framework, and monitoring systems for AI applications, and ensure continuous improvement of engineering practices
Implement observability, reliability, and performance optimizations for agent platform in production
Ensure compliance to architecture principle, technical standards, security requirements and software development life cycle controls
Qualifications
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related subject area
15+ of experience in developing and implementing software solutions, with 5+ years in technical leadership roles.
Hands-on experience in design and development of agentic AI solutions
Proven and deep experience in designing, building, and delivering a large-scale Agent platform
Deep understanding of the agent paradigm, including agent planning, short-term and long-term memory, tool use, agent orchestration and agent evaluation
Experience with high code and low code agent platform
Strong experience in designing and building scalable and resilient platform
Proven ability in building and managing high performing teams of AI SME and full stack engineers
Solid hands-on development skills in programming language such as Java, Python, and CI/CD tools, automation testing, and observability
Proficiency in effective stakeholder management, and capable of effectively articulating AI capabilities, and influencing both business and technology leaders
Experience working in Agile development teams with excellent collaboration skills

Principal Responsibilities
Reporting & stakeholders: The role reports to the Pod Lead (PO) or Product Manager (as defined by the pod operating model). The UI/UX Designer works day-to-day with Business Analysts, engineers (AI/ML Engineers, Forward Deployed Engineers and front-end/full-stack engineers), the QA/Testing Lead and the Tech Delivery Lead to ensure designs are buildable, testable and delivered to schedule. They partner closely with Change & Adoption Lead to support adoption through intuitive journeys and, where needed, in-product guidance. The role also collaborates with the AI Solution Architect, data/platform teams and the Responsible AI Practitioner to ensure AI-enabled experiences are transparent, safe and aligned to Group AI standards. Where required, they engage in Risk, Compliance, Legal, Privacy and Information Security to ensure that experience design supports approvals, required disclosures and evidence expectations in a regulated environment.
Scope & authority: The UI/UX Designer owns the end-to-end experience design for the pod’s AI-enabled features, from journey mapping and interaction design through to UI pattern definition, prototyping and usability validation. They are accountable for producing clear, build-ready design outputs - clickable prototypes, annotated user flows, content guidance and detailed design specifications (components, states, accessibility notes and error handling) - so delivery teams can implement with pace and minimal rework. They have the authority to propose and recommend experience options and trade-offs, grounded in user evidence and delivery constraints, including decisions around automation vs human oversight, transparency vs friction and handling of AI uncertainty and failure modes. Final decisions on product scope, investment and priority remain with the Pod Lead, but the UI/UX Designer is accountable for ensuring experience risks are surfaced early, addressed through design, and aligned to design system standards, Responsible AI expectations and required governance/approvals. The role does not own product prioritisation or backlog decisions; it influences these through tested prototypes, user evidence and clear experience trade-offs
Knowledge & Experience/Qualifications
This role exists to ensure AI-enabled solutions are designed around real user needs, are easy to use, and build trust - reducing rework and driving adoption. The UI/UX Designer brings clarity to complex AI behaviours through strong interaction design, validated journeys and production-ready specs.
Target journey & product definition - Partner with Pod Lead/PO, BA and business stakeholders to define the target user journeys and key moments that AI will improve. Translate AI capabilities/constraints (confidence, latency, failure modes, monitoring) into clear experience patterns and user expectations. Ensure the experience supports end-to-end outcomes, not isolated screens (e.g., request → decision/support → follow-up → audit trail).
UX discovery, research & testing standards - Plan and run lightweight discovery: stakeholder interviews, contextual enquiry, workflow walkthroughs and heuristic reviews. Define hypotheses and success measures for experience quality (task success, time-on-task, error rate, comprehension of AI outputs). Run rapid, repeatable usability testing on prototypes and early builds to validate journeys and UI patterns, synthesise findings, and drive iterative design improvements.
UI patterns, prototyping & design specification - Create wireframes and high-fidelity prototypes for key flows, edge cases and system states (loading, low confidence, refusal, escalation). Provide build-ready design specifications covering components, states, empty/error cases, accessibility notes, responsive behaviour and content guidance to support build and QA. Promote reuse by applying approved design systems and reusable components/patterns; propose new components only when justified and document rationale for reuse.
Design alignment to Responsible AI and control expectations - Embed “trust cues” and transparency: what the AI did, why, confidence/limits, and what users should do next. Design for safe use: appropriate human oversight, escalation paths, confirmation steps, and prevention of harmful/incorrect actions. Partner with Responsible AI Practitioner and control functions to ensure design supports required evidence and approvals (e.g., disclosures, decision records, audit trail touchpoints).
Delivery collaboration & quality in execution - Work closely with engineers and QA to ensure designs are implemented as intended; join backlog refinement and sprint ceremonies as needed. Support design QA: verify UI implementation, interaction fidelity, accessibility compliance and content accuracy. Keep design artefacts current (journey maps, prototypes, specs) so decisions remain traceable and delivery stays unblocked.
Adoption and change support (experience-led) - Partner with Change & Adoption Lead to ensure the solution is intuitive, learnable and supported by in-product guidance where needed. Identify friction points likely to reduce adoption and recommend design changes, onboarding or comms mitigations.
/WX

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Manager, Data and Analytics.

Principal responsibilities

  • Lead the end-to-end delivery of analytics solutions, from understanding business needs through to implementation and continuous improvement.
  • Translate complex business questions into practical analytical approaches, meaningful insights and clear recommendations for senior stakeholders.
  • Identify opportunities to use data and advanced analytics to improve customer outcomes, manage risk, enhance operational effectiveness and support business performance.
  • Manage delivery priorities, risks, dependencies and stakeholder expectations across multiple initiatives.
  • Lead, coach and develop colleagues while promoting collaboration, inclusion and a strong data-led culture.

Requirements

  • Strong professional experience delivering data analytics solutions in banking or financial services.
  • Proven ability to lead analytical projects and convert business requirements into practical, high-quality outputs.
  • Strong understanding of data structures, data modelling, data visualisation, reporting platforms and analytical techniques.
  • Ability to communicate complex data and analytical findings clearly to senior stakeholders and audiences with different levels of technical expertise.
  • Strong problem-solving, prioritisation and delivery skills, with the ability to manage competing demands and deliver results at pace.
  • Demonstrated experience leading teams, programmes or workstreams, with a collaborative and inclusive approach to people leadership.
  • A degree or equivalent professional qualification in data science, analytics, computer science, statistics, mathematics, engineering, business or a related discipline.
  • Fluency in Cantonese, English and Mandarin, with strong written and verbal communication skills.

Candidate with less relevant experience or skills may be offered a lower Global Career Band than stated above.

Due to the urgent hiring need, candidates with immediate right to work locally and no relocation need will be prioritised.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Our local presence and international network enable us to capture the strong structural tailwinds which are driving cross-border wealth flows. Our comprehensive product offerings span across deposits, payments, financing, advisory, investments and bancassurance.

Source and engage individual prospects to acquire new business.
Conduct professional, consultative financial analysis sessions with customers.
Identify and articulate customers’ specific financial needs and objectives, offering targeted solutions.
Foster and deepen client relationships by providing regular market updates and financial product trend analysis (both local and international).
Participate in marketing and promotional activities aimed at successful customer acquisition.
Skills And Experience
Strong competencies in client acquisition and sophisticated account management, particularly with High Net Worth (HNW) individuals.
Expertise in region-specific languages and established local networks (highly valued).
Technical knowledge of consumer banking products (Treasury, Equities, Funds, and Insurance).
A university degree is preferred.
Relevant experience in customer service or sales is an advantage; however, applications from fresh graduates who possess the required skills and qualifications will also be considered.

Essential professional qualifications: HKSI Paper 1, 7, 8 and IIQE Paper 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
